# Cultural Disposition

Cultural, religious, and regulatory constraints on how an asset or property may be disposed of. Covers sacred status, disposal restrictions, export controls, and whether the item can be bequeathed

Source: [`v3/common/cultural-disposition.json`](../../../v3/common/cultural-disposition.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/common/cultural-disposition.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sacredStatus` | one of `secular`, `consecrated`, `ritually_significant`, `inalienable_endowment` | | Whether this item has religious or spiritual significance that restricts disposal |
| `culturalSignificance` | one of `personal`, `family_heirloom`, `community`, `national_heritage` | | The cultural weight of this item — determines who should be consulted about its disposition |
| `bequeathable` | `boolean` | | Whether this item can be willed to another person. False for waqf endowments, some ancestral property, and inalienable cultural artefacts |
| `disposalRestrictions` | array of `object` | | Specific restrictions on how this item may be disposed of, with the authority that imposes each restriction |
| `exportRestrictions` | array of `object` | | Legal restrictions on exporting this item from its current jurisdiction |
